# Keeping AI safe, secure, and reliable

## Your Trusted Partner (Since 2018)

For nearly a decade, we’ve been the backbone of online trust and safety. With the world’s top safety and security minds, we’re continuously protecting over 3 billion people across the internet.  (Yes, that probably includes you.) Now we’re bringing those exact capabilities to the age of GenAI.

[![Open book with a blue river, paper boat, and pastel rainbow emerging from the pages.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69005ca0f0832195cbc1370c/6a96d54d57238b4e24ae14a7__quantized%201%20%5BVectorized%5D.svg)\\
Explain it to me like I'm 5 →](https://go.alice.io/sir-gavin-and-the-wonderland-waterfall)

RELENTLESS INTELLIGENCE

## Built on human expertise. Advanced by ground breaking technology.

Powered by unparalleled real-world abuse intelligence, Alice’s models spot threats that typically slip through the cracks. We stay ahead of evolving threats and adapt to new attack methods, proactively protecting communicative technologies and the people who use them from harm.

[Go down the Rabbit Hole](https://alice.io/intelligence)

## Guardians of communicative tech

Our leaders are seasoned experts in safety, security and AI, with decades of experience on the front-lines of human-tech safety.
